L1.01.title: Sounds in Words
L1.01.goal: Hear that spoken words are made of separate sounds, and blend/segment 2–3-sound words *orally* — no letters yet, except a 60-second preview of two shapes at the very end.
L1.01.newToday: oral phonemic awareness (blending, segmenting), mouth-position awareness.
L1.01.time: 15–20 minutes (shorter than later lessons on purpose).

L1.02.title: s a t
L1.02.goal: Read and spell the letters s, a, t by sound; blend them into the only real words they can currently make.
L1.02.newToday: letters s, a, t (sounds /s/, /æ/, /t/) — **one new sound per sitting** (see below), not all three in a single session.
L1.02.review: yesterday's oral blending games (2 min recap only).
L1.02.heartLine: a, I (taught in the final combined sitting, once s/a/t are all in).
L1.02.time: four short sittings — A (~10 min), B (~10 min), C (~15 min), D (~25–30 min). Run one sitting per session (research/01 §5 rule 2: cap new-GPC introduction, mastery-gated, not calendar-gated), or see the fast-track note below.

L1.03.title: p i n
L1.03.goal: Read and spell p, i, n; blend the growing letter set into a full first wave of real CVC words.
L1.03.newToday: letters p, i, n (sounds /p/, /ɪ/, /n/) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.03.review: s, a, t; the words at, as, sat.
L1.03.heartLine: the, is (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.03.time: four sittings — A (~15 min), B (~15 min), C (~15 min), D (~25–30 min).

L1.04.title: m d
L1.04.goal: Read and spell m, d; blend an 8-letter set into a richer bank of real CVC words, including the first simple family/scene sentences.
L1.04.newToday: letters m, d (sounds /m/, /d/) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.04.review: s, a, t, p, i, n.
L1.04.heartLine: to, of (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.04.time: three sittings — A (~15 min), B (~15 min), C (~25–30 min).

L1.05.title: g o
L1.05.goal: Read and spell g, o; unlock a full vocabulary of common CVC words (got, dog, mop, top…) and the first fully regular heart word, "and."
L1.05.newToday: letters g, o (sounds /g/, /ɒ/ — short o) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.05.review: s, a, t, p, i, n, m, d.
L1.05.heartLine: and, was (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.05.time: three sittings — A (~15 min), B (~15 min), C (~25–30 min).

L1.06.title: c k ck
L1.06.goal: Read and spell the two spellings of /k/ (c and k) plus the digraph ck; unlock words like "cat," "sick," "sack," "dock."
L1.06.newToday: c, k (both say /k/), ck (also says /k/, used at the end of a word right after a short vowel) — **one new grapheme per sitting**, since all three spell the same sound.
L1.06.review: g, o; words got, dog, top.
L1.06.heartLine: said, you (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.06.time: four sittings — A (~12 min), B (~12 min), C (~15 min), D (~25–30 min).

L1.07.title: e u
L1.07.goal: Read and spell e, u; open up a large new set of CVC words (cut, ten, sun, den…).
L1.07.newToday: letters e, u (sounds /ɛ/ — short e, /ʌ/ — short u) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.07.review: c, k, ck; words cat, sick, sock.
L1.07.heartLine: are, he (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.07.time: three sittings — A (~15 min), B (~15 min), C (~25–30 min).

L1.08.title: r h
L1.08.goal: Read and spell r, h; unlock "rat," "hat," "run" — and, since both letters are now taught, turn yesterday's two heart words ("are," "he") fully or partly decodable.
L1.08.newToday: letters r, h (sounds /r/, /h/) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.08.review: e, u; words cut, ten, sun.
L1.08.heartLine: she, we (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.08.time: three sittings — A (~15 min), B (~15 min), C (~25–30 min).

L1.09.title: b f l
L1.09.goal: Read and spell b, f, l; add two more fully decodable "heart" words (me, be) now that b is taught.
L1.09.newToday: letters b, f, l (sounds /b/, /f/, /l/) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.09.review: r, h; words rat, hop, hat.
L1.09.heartLine: me, be (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.09.time: four sittings — A (~12 min), B (~12 min), C (~12 min), D (~25–30 min).

L1.10.title: ff, ll, ss, zz (FLOSS) + the -s plural
L1.10.goal: Learn the doubling spelling rule (FLOSS) and the -s ending for "more than one" and for matching verbs to "he/she/it" — the first two spelling/grammar *rules* in the course, not just new sounds.
L1.10.newToday: the FLOSS rule (f, l, s, z double at the end of a short word right after one short vowel: doll, bell, kiss, buzz); the -s ending.
L1.10.review: b, f, l; words fan, big, bag.

L1.11.title: j v w
L1.11.goal: Read and spell j, v, w — and, since w is now taught, retire "was" and "we" from fully-heart status.
L1.11.newToday: letters j, v, w (sounds /dʒ/, /v/, /w/) — **one new sound per sitting**.
L1.11.heartLine: they, one (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.11.time: four sittings — A (~12 min), B (~12 min), C (~15 min), D (~25–30 min).

L1.12.title: x y z qu
L1.12.goal: Read and spell x, y, z, and the qu spelling; the alphabet's sounds are now complete (all 26 letters covered across L1.02–L1.12).
L1.12.newToday: x (usually says /ks/, two sounds in one letter), y (as a consonant, /j/, at the start of a word — its vowel jobs come in Level 3), z, qu (always together, says /kw/) — **one new grapheme per sitting**.
L1.12.review: j, v, w; words jam, van, wet.
L1.12.heartLine: have, go (taught in the final combined sitting).
L1.12.time: five sittings — A (~12 min), B (~10 min), C (~10 min), D (~10 min), E (~25–30 min).

L1.13.title: Review: All Letters, Letter Names vs. Sounds, b/d/p/q
L1.13.goal: Consolidate all 26 letters and their sounds; explicitly separate letter *name* from letter *sound*; directly address the b/d/p/q mirror-confusion as its own short, dedicated lesson.
L1.13.newToday: no new letter-sounds — this is a consolidation lesson, plus one genuinely new skill: telling b/d/p/q apart reliably.
L1.13.time: 25–30 minutes (slightly longer — this is a full review lesson), single sitting.

L1.14.title: Level 1 Mastery Check
L1.14.goal: Confirm the learner reads and spells real CVC words and pseudowords at ≥90%, knows all 26 letter-sounds, all 24 heart words, and reliably tells apart b/d/p/q — the Level 1 exit gate.
L1.14.newToday: nothing new — this session administers the full instrument.
L1.14.heartLine: cumulative review only (all 24, no new ones).
L1.14.time: 20–30 minutes, can be split across two short sessions if needed (this is a test session, not a teaching one — fatigue affects the score, so don't push through if the learner is visibly tired).
